lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 12 distinct vertical white lines identified; spacing is widest in the mid-torso and becomes progressively narrower toward the anterior shoulder and posterior rump.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating approximately halfway down the torso height; a distinct break is visible in the line located directly above the hind limb near the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: 4 high-contrast white spots are located on the lateral haunch and upper hind limb.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: 3 spots on the upper-mid thigh form a semi-connected diagonal geometric alignment angled toward the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Two white spots on the lower mandible/cheek; prominent white chevron patch on the throat; white interior fringe on the pinnae; dark facial mask extending from eyes to muzzle.
